details:
Posted this on VRC Discord earlier so here’s some feedback and suggestion.
1. The increased camera smoothness is fine, but…
when you move forward while the camera is close to the user, the camera lags behind and will clip through the user’s body. A camera smoothing slider could help this so user can choose the desired smoothing depending on what they need.
2. Ability to grab the camera even further (or with no distance limit)
so it’s easier to position the camera further from the user (I’m aware we have Drone now, but I like to grab the camera itself when positioning the camera).
3. Camera screen resizer.
I’ve suggested this before but I hope it’ll come in the next big update. Due to the nature of VR headset, it’s hard to see the screen up close so enlarging it would be cool… or you can make it smaller and pretend that you’re holding a phone in your hand when taking mirror selfie (combined with enable all UI in the mirror).
4. Change the Drone controls
I find it hard to take pics while flying the drone at the same time since holding the trigger tilts the camera (with right thumbstick). I mean, I could just point mu left hand pointer to the “Take Photo” button but it’s hard to try to keep your left hand steady and fly the camera around. Maybe the Left Trigger can be used to take photo while still flying the drone.
A custom controller mapper can also help so users can have better control over their drone.
5. Make the camera lock button more apparent.
I didn’t realize this exist until someone pointed it out. Maybe put a lock button somewhere on the camera screen (like the new main menu lock icon) instead of scrolling to the end to lock it.
6. Activate Mic icon when sound is detected.
This option can help users to have a balance between immersive and functional. The Mic icon is hidden when there is no sound detected, and then it will automatically show when sound is detected. This also includes when users turn off their mic. Not everyone wants to see the mic icon, but at least a bit of indication that their mic is working is better than hiding the mic icon entirely.
Love the new open beta! I’m still waiting for the camera animation feature (which you did mention previously that it may come with the final UI 2.0 update).
title: [1237] General feedback (UI and Camera)
